say:1:1230424001:1.text: Raid? That's terrible! How dare they do such a thing?
say:1:1230424001:1.source_cn: 劫掠？这太可怕了，他们怎么敢这样？
say:1:1230424001:1.male: Raid? That's terrible! How dare they do such a thing?
say:1:1230424001:1.female: Raid? That's terrible! How dare they do such a thing?

say:2:1230424002:1.text: No wonder I've been hearing a lot of commotion lately.
say:2:1230424002:1.source_cn: 我就说最近总能听到一些打打杀杀的声音。
say:2:1230424002:1.male: No wonder I've been hearing a lot of commotion lately.
say:2:1230424002:1.female: No wonder I've been hearing a lot of commotion lately.

say:3:1230424003:1.text: Thankfully, I wasn't curious enough to look into things at that time.
say:3:1230424003:1.source_cn: 还好我当时没有因为好奇心凑过去看。
say:3:1230424003:1.male: Thankfully, I wasn't curious enough to look into things at that time.
say:3:1230424003:1.female: Thankfully, I wasn't curious enough to look into things at that time.
